topic: IRS VITA/TCE grants FY2027 selected applicants
category: Tax credits and free tax prep
why: IRS selected VITA grantees for Oct 1, 2026 to Sept 30, 2027; they need to reach EITC-eligible filers before the 2027 filing season (IRS: about 1 in 5 eligible don't claim EITC).
ONDCP's September 2026 list of new DFC coalitions; 5-year grants up to $125,000/yr starting Sept 30, 2026, with 'provide information' (incl. PSAs) as the first strategy.

topic: Federal Medicaid work requirements start January 1, 2027
why: Expansion adults must meet work/community-engagement rules from Jan 1, 2027; Georgia's waiver expires Dec 31, 2026 and must then follow federal rules. Arizona: AHCCCS and partners launched KeepMyAHCCCS.com (Sept 9, 2026); nearly 417,000 members could be affected from Jan 1, 2027.

topic: Michigan MDHHS community navigator network (Healthy Michigan Plan + SNAP)
why: About $12.25M grant (MCNP-2027) for a nonprofit-led statewide navigator network for residents affected by H.R. 1; applications were due Sept 30, 2026, awards not yet announced (still no awardee list on the MDHHS release as of Nov 24, 2026). Watch for grantees and secondary partners.

topic: Nebraska Medicaid expansion work requirements (phased May 2026 to June 2027)
why: Took effect May 1, 2026; first existing members affected at July 31, 2026 renewals, phased through June 2027. DHHS partnered with SHARE Omaha, United Way of the Midlands and county partners (June 30, 2026).

topic: Drug-Free Communities FY2026 recompete new awards (FY2025 recompete, July 2026 list)
why: ONDCP's July 2026 list of FY2026 DFC new awards from the FY2025 recompete names about 100 coalitions; CDC's related DFC notice (CE-26-0208) funds up to $125,000 per 12-month budget period for five years, with providing information (PSAs, social media) as a strategy.

topic: CMS ACA Navigator awardees, 2026-2027 budget period
why: CMS Navigator third budget period runs Aug 27, 2026 to Aug 26, 2027 (period of performance to Aug 26, 2029); no CMS Navigator funding in Oklahoma after its move to a state-based exchange on the federal platform (May 1, 2026). Nearly all awardees in Armin/Stefan states are already on the desks.

topic: Philadelphia Office of Worker Protections Community Outreach and Education Fund 2026-27 round
why: $100,000 for 4 to 6 community groups ($16,000-$25,000 each) to teach worker protections; applications closed Nov 6, 2026, awards expected December 2026, programs through June 2027. Watch for the grantee list. Prior cohort: Philadelphia Black Worker Project, NDWA PA Chapter, Restaurant Workers Coalition / El Comité, VietLead.

topic: Michigan MDHHS opioid-settlement youth substance use prevention grants (June 2026)
why: MDHHS awarded nearly $3.75 million to 12 community organizations (up to $375,000 each) to prevent substance use among school-age youth, funded with opioid settlement dollars; work includes prevention education and family-strengthening supports. Grant period not stated.

topic: ONDCP FY2026 CARA Local Drug Crisis grants (September 2026)
why: ONDCP's Sept. 22, 2026 release: about $3.8 million in CARA Local Drug Crisis grants to 50 coalitions for primary prevention focused on youth use of opioids, methamphetamine and prescription drug misuse (alongside about $66 million in DFC awards). Award list PDF not yet read; mine it on a later run.

topic: Oklahoma Opioid Abatement Board grant round (applications Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026)
why: Over $12 million awarded Aug 13, 2026 to 24 political subdivisions (cities/counties, not nonprofits); next round open Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026, awards expected March/April 2027. Watch for nonprofit subgrantees or partners of the awarded cities/counties.
